evidence.quote: For kit-based builds, consume the existing kit authentication and authorization primitives and verify them through AUTH-WALK. Do not rebuild login pages, an auth store, metadata role flags or a client route guard. Page wrappers follow STARTER_KIT_HANDBOOK §5 and §7: resolve authorized server data before rendering the interactive client child. Generic non-kit examples do not apply when the kit supplies the capability.

The role table is the only authorization authority. Never authorize from user_metadata or a profile mirror. Superadmin creation is console-only; no app-side superadmin creation route is provided. Retire the metadata-authorized add-user, delete-user and get-users recipes. Future privileged list/delete operations remain possible only with trusted current-role lookup, operation-local authorization before elevated capability, an approved target-role allowlist and privileged-target protection. Profile mirrors contain profile data, not authorization columns. Registration metadata is not authorization.

Every privileged operation authorizes its own invocation before acquiring or using elevated capability: authenticate the requester, resolve the current trusted role, authorize the operation and target, and validate input. Layout admission controls page access only. Direct unauthenticated, wrong-role and wrong-target invocations must produce no privileged side effect.

Verify authentication state, table-backed current role, object-level authorization, denied targets, session expiry, logout and first server render. The former metadata-role/auth-store checklist is withdrawn. Kit-dependent signatures require the pinned kit evidence; this containment does not close those replacements.

**User creation requires a verified trusted role path.** Never permit client-writable metadata to grant privilege. Verify the pinned trigger and protected admin action before using creation-time transport; avoid duplicate inserts only where the verified trigger already owns those rows. Missing kit evidence blocks this recipe.

> **Q3.4:** inspect both authorization reads and creation-time writes. User-writable metadata must never grant privilege, including through a trigger. A protected caller alone does not make a shared metadata field trustworthy: prove that public signup cannot supply the privileged value. Record the pinned role table, resolver, trigger and caller evidence; otherwise flag the path as unsafe.

Roles must resolve from an authoritative server-side store. Creation and mutation require verified per-call authorization and a role input that untrusted signup cannot control. The historical Mark IV transport is not a verified safe recipe for the current kit; obtain pinned trigger and caller evidence before implementation.

**Authorization:** the server action itself must authenticate and authorize each invocation before any privileged client call. A route-group layout is not an action authorization boundary. Resolve roles from the authoritative server store and allow only explicitly permitted target roles. Do not use a user-writable metadata trigger to assign privilege. The historical action/trigger recipe is withdrawn pending pinned kit verification.
- Privileged account creation and role promotion require the approved project authority and verified kit path; do not treat a silent downgrade or manual console workaround as successful creation.

- Historical Mark IV role-from-metadata behavior is unverified for safe public signup. Do not adopt it: privileged assignment must be inaccessible to client-controlled input and proven against pinned trigger/caller source.
Verify the pinned trigger’s name field and role input contract. Public user metadata must never grant privilege; protected admin creation alone does not prove a shared trigger safe.

Do not persist raw contact details by default. Any approved personal-data persistence declares permitted fields, retention duration and user or guest scope. Sign-out and account transition reset and invalidate every affected store even when remote logout fails; a new account must not hydrate the previous account’s data. Payment and authorization state remain outside persistence. Storage readiness is separate from business-data reset.

Keep hydration readiness outside the resettable business state. A normal reset preserves readiness. Hydration finishes in ready or error; an error exposes bounded recovery and never leaves an indefinite loading state. Verify reset after hydration, invalid stored data and unavailable storage.

The removed example’s missing contract is still tracked; no universal quote/subscription schema is introduced.

The browser may display or poll payment status; it may not choose paid or processing state. A payment-derived transition requires verified server-side evidence bound to the stored order and payment attempt, including amount and currency. Non-webhook mutations authenticate and authorize the operation and target, including an explicitly approved guest capability where supported, then validate the state transition.

Accept product/variation identifiers, quantities, shipping selection and coupon code, never caller prices, shipping costs or discount amounts. Validate quantities and product eligibility; load authoritative catalog prices; validate the shipping selection and coupon eligibility; apply the declared tax policy; calculate currency-safe totals on the server. Bind the payment to the authorized order and verify payment identity, amount, currency and order association before marking paid. Client totals are display-only. Return generic failures and redact logs. Universal quote-storage design is deferred; the required server pricing and payment binding still apply.

Persist one authorized checkout-attempt identity across retries and claim it atomically against concurrent requests. Scope provider idempotency keys to that attempt and operation, reuse or retrieve existing external objects after an unknown outcome, and reconcile before creating a replacement. Use the project-approved customer-identity contract without assuming paid activation; universal subscription schema design is deferred. Handle every documented subscription state, not only active.

Use one validated checkout contract across form, state, route and service. The request carries billing.email, validated line identifiers/quantities, shippingMethod and couponCode; it carries no authoritative monetary values. The response identifies the authorized order/payment attempt or a typed generic failure. The server pricing operation from the same contract supplies totals. Revisions to items, shipping or coupon invalidate the old payment binding before a new attempt is released.
